tools.name: Currency Exchange_Get Exchange Rate
tools.description: Automatically gets the exchange rate from the source currency into the destination currency using the latest available currency exchange rate data.

source.description: Source currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

destination.description: Destination currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

tools.name: Currency Exchange_Get Available Currencies
tools.description: Enumerates available currencies and the countries that correspond to these currencies.

tools.name: Currency Exchange_Convert Currency
tools.description: Automatically converts the price in the source currency into the destination currency using the latest available currency exchange rate data.

source.description: Source currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.

destination.description: Destination currency three-digit code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, etc.
